All 5 tabs (Teklif/Katalog/Geçmiş/Müşteri/Firma) are present in the tab bar; EK DOSYALAR section header + 'Dosya Yükle' button + 'WhatsApp Gönder' button are all visible on the Teklif screen. critical_code_review_comments: pdf-merge.ts: EXCELLENT fix. Platform gate is placed after the empty-attachments guard so `if (attachments.length===0) return basePdfUri;` still short-circuits before the platform check — both fast paths are correct. The lazy `require('pdf-lib')` uses `as typeof import('pdf-lib')` to preserve type safety without importing at compile-time (TS ambient types only). The dead branch at lines 122-125 (`if (Platform.OS === 'web')` after the merge succeeds) is unreachable because of the early return at line 72 — safe to remove for clarity but not a bug.

pdf-merge.ts:53: readAsBase64 falls through to FileSystem.readAsStringAsync for non-blob non-data URIs. On web this would only be reached if someone passes a plain http(s) URL — currently no caller does. Safe.
whatsapp.ts: unchanged from iter6 review — single-step Sharing.shareAsync on native, two-tab window.open() on web, sanitised teklifNo filename, getInfoAsync existence check, mimeType + UTI both set.

Consider `/\.docx?$/i`. Non-blocking (carry-over from iter6).

rca_of_issue: The iter6 crash was caused by pdf-lib@1.17.1's nested tslib@1.14.1 (installed as node_modules/pdf-lib/node_modules/tslib because top-level tslib is 2.x and cannot be deduped across majors). tslib 1.14.1's package.json declares `exports['.'].import = './modules/index.js'`, and Metro on web honours that condition. modules/index.js does `import tslib from '../tslib.js'; const { __extends, ... } = tslib.default;` — Metro's CJS↔ESM interop materialises tslib.js's `module.exports` such that `.default` is undefined, throwing at module load. Because pdf-merge.ts had `import { PDFDocument } from 'pdf-lib'` at the top, the crash fired the moment the (tabs)/index.tsx route bundle was evaluated, killing every tab. The applied fix removes the top-level import entirely and platform-gates the function so Metro's web tree-shaker never resolves pdf-lib. On native, `require('pdf-lib')` runs under Hermes where the CJS interop works, so full merge support is retained. Verified reproduction now returns 0 console errors and 0 page errors after fresh register + onboard + reload — Teklif screen renders with 'EK DOSYALAR' section, 'Dosya Yükle' + 'WhatsApp Gönder' buttons, and all 5 tabs present.
